rationale: EMBJ is trading at 99.5% of its intraday range after a 3.8% gap-up open, sitting essentially at the session high with no news catalyst to explain the move and no pullback to offer a favorable risk/reward entry on the long side. A short against the high is equally unattractive given the strong momentum and the stock is already extended well above VWAP ($81.58) and the 9-EMA ($82.23), making mean-reversion timing uncertain. With the daily loss budget already partially consumed and no clear structural level to anchor a stop, the asymmetry does not justify a new position.
